remarks: Located in a sought-after neighborhood, 12 Fowler St is just moments away from local shops, restaurants, parks, and schools.  Discover this meticulously updated single-family home nestled in the vibrant core of Mid-City. This charming residence seamlessly blends modern amenities with timeless appeal, featuring brand-new hardwood floors and a state-of-the-art Carrier 24 SEER split system, new windows and doors throughout. With 4 bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, this home offers a bright, open-concept living area ideal for hosting gatherings. The enclosed porch adds an extra touch of comfort, perfect for year-round enjoyment. The newly remodeled kitchen is equipped with stainless steel appliances, 6-burner gas stove, sleek granite countertops, and plenty of cabinet storage. Outside, the private backyard provides a serene space for relaxation or entertaining. Additional features include a detached garage and an extended driveway, offering ample off-street parking and extra storage. Don't miss the chance to call this beautifully updated rental property HOME!
